prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” for everyone — the right AI video ad maker depends on your format, budget, and goals. That said, the most widely recommended options by use case are below.

If you want one quick pick
- Best overall for professional-looking AI presenter ads: Synthesia — realistic avatars, many languages, good brand controls. Great if your ads need a talking host or multilingual voiceovers.

Top choices by use case
- AI presenters / spokesperson videos: Synthesia, HeyGen, Elai.io, Colossyan — choose Synthesia for maturity and features; HeyGen/Elai as often slightly cheaper alternatives.
- Fast templated social ads (Stories/Reels/Feed): InVideo, Promo.com, Shakr, Clipchamp — lots of ad-ready templates and aspect ratio options.
- Turn blog posts or long-form content into short ads: Pictory, Lumen5 — good at summarizing and auto-editing text → video.
- Edit + AI voiceover / overdub + transcription: Descript — excellent for fine-grain editing and realistic overdub voices.
- Advanced creative / generative visuals and compositing: Runway (and Kaiber for stylized generative clips) — best if you need novel visuals or creative effects.
- Scale & optimization for performance ads (A/B at scale, centralized production): VidMob, Shakr — built for ad teams and e-commerce.

Key differences to consider
- Output style: avatar presenter vs. stock footage vs. fully generated visuals.
- Customizability: templates vs. full editing control.
- Languages & voices: some tools support dozens of languages and accents; others focus on English.
- Price: enterprise-grade (Synthesia, VidMob) can be pricey; Clipchamp, InVideo, Pictory are more budget-friendly.
- Workflow: single-creator vs. team features, brand kits, collaboration and analytics.

How to pick quickly
1. Define format (talking head, UGC-style, animated, text→video).
2. Set budget and required languages/voices.
3. Try free tiers/trials — make one real ad and test performance.
4. Evaluate speed, brand consistency, and ability to A/B variants.

If you tell me: budget, ad format, target platform (Meta, TikTok, YouTube), and whether you need avatars or your own footage, I’ll recommend 2–3 concrete options and which plan to try first.
